name: xAI
summary: xAI is an AI company that Elon Musk founded in 2023. It makes the Grok models and the Grok chatbot on X. It is now part of [SpaceX](https://apnews.com/article/spacex-xai-musk-space-2079f03fa888652b7fe836afe8b670a1) and is called SpaceXAI.

incidents.title: xAI's Grok Gave False Ballot Deadlines Before the 2024 US Election
incidents.summary: After President Biden left the race, Grok said that ballot deadlines had passed in nine states. This was false. [Five secretaries of state wrote to Musk](https://www.sos.mn.gov/media/6077/080524-secretaries-letter-to-x.pdf) to ask for a fix.
incidents.description: After President Biden left the race, Grok told X users that ballot deadlines had passed in nine US states, [according to five secretaries of state](https://www.sos.mn.gov/media/6077/080524-secretaries-letter-to-x.pdf). The letter says that the false answer reached millions of people before it was corrected. The secretaries [asked X to fix Grok](https://apnews.com/article/election-2024-misinformation-x-twitter-elon-musk-230cc0e99b3f490585bdff66a29e079a) and to send election questions to CanIVote.org.

timeline.title: Grok starts to give false ballot deadlines
timeline.description: Grok said that ballot deadlines had passed in nine states, [according to the secretaries of state](https://www.sos.mn.gov/media/6077/080524-secretaries-letter-to-x.pdf).

timeline.title: Answer corrected
timeline.description: The false answer was corrected after about ten days, [according to the letter](https://www.sos.mn.gov/media/6077/080524-secretaries-letter-to-x.pdf).

timeline.title: Five secretaries of state write to Musk
timeline.description: The secretaries of Minnesota, Michigan, New Mexico, Pennsylvania, and Washington [asked X to fix Grok](https://apnews.com/article/election-2024-misinformation-x-twitter-elon-musk-230cc0e99b3f490585bdff66a29e079a).

incidents.title: xAI's Grok 3 Prompt Told It to Ignore Sources Saying Musk or Trump Spread Misinformation
incidents.summary: Users found that Grok 3 was told to ignore sources that said Elon Musk or Donald Trump spread misinformation. [xAI's engineering lead blamed a former OpenAI employee](https://fortune.com/2025/02/24/xai-chief-engineer-blames-former-openai-employee-grok-blocks-musk-trump-misinformation/) and said the change was reverted.
incidents.description: In February 2025, users found that the system prompt of xAI's Grok 3 told the model to ignore sources that said Elon Musk or Donald Trump spread misinformation, [The Verge reported](https://www.theverge.com/news/618109/grok-blocked-elon-musk-trump-misinformation). An xAI engineering lead [blamed a former OpenAI employee](https://fortune.com/2025/02/24/xai-chief-engineer-blames-former-openai-employee-grok-blocks-musk-trump-misinformation/) who had joined xAI. He said that xAI reverted the change after users found it.

timeline.title: Users find the instruction
timeline.description: Users shared Grok 3 output that showed the instruction, [according to TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2025/02/23/grok-3-appears-to-have-briefly-censored-unflattering-mentions-of-trump-and-musk/).

timeline.title: xAI blames an employee and reverts the change
timeline.description: Babuschkin blamed a former OpenAI employee, [Fortune reported](https://fortune.com/2025/02/24/xai-chief-engineer-blames-former-openai-employee-grok-blocks-musk-trump-misinformation/).

incidents.title: xAI API Keys Leaked on GitHub
incidents.summary: Two xAI API keys were reportedly left in public GitHub code in 2025. One, from an xAI employee, gave access to [at least 60 private models](https://krebsonsecurity.com/2025/05/xai-dev-leaks-api-key-for-private-spacex-tesla-llms/). The other, from DOGE staff member Marko Elez, gave access to [52 models](https://krebsonsecurity.com/2025/07/doge-denizen-marko-elez-leaked-api-key-for-xai/).
incidents.description: An xAI employee reportedly put an API key in public GitHub code. The key gave access to private Grok models, some of which GitGuardian said were possibly tuned on SpaceX and Tesla data, and [KrebsOnSecurity reported](https://krebsonsecurity.com/2025/05/xai-dev-leaks-api-key-for-private-spacex-tesla-llms/) that the repository was removed after an alert to xAI. Later, a DOGE staff member reportedly leaked [a second key for 52 xAI models](https://krebsonsecurity.com/2025/07/doge-denizen-marko-elez-leaked-api-key-for-xai/).

timeline.title: GitGuardian detects the first leaked key
timeline.description: GitGuardian emailed the xAI employee who committed the key, [according to KrebsOnSecurity](https://krebsonsecurity.com/2025/05/xai-dev-leaks-api-key-for-private-spacex-tesla-llms/).

timeline.title: xAI security team alerted; repository removed
timeline.description: The key still worked when GitGuardian alerted xAI; the repository was removed a few hours later, [KrebsOnSecurity reported](https://krebsonsecurity.com/2025/05/xai-dev-leaks-api-key-for-private-spacex-tesla-llms/).

timeline.title: DOGE staff member leaks a second key
timeline.description: Marko Elez reportedly published a script with an xAI key that gave access to 52 models, [according to KrebsOnSecurity](https://krebsonsecurity.com/2025/07/doge-denizen-marko-elez-leaked-api-key-for-xai/).

incidents.title: xAI's Grok Inserted “White Genocide” Claims Into Unrelated Replies
incidents.summary: Grok replied to many unrelated questions on X with claims about “white genocide” in South Africa. [xAI said](https://techcrunch.com/2025/05/15/xai-blames-groks-obsession-with-white-genocide-on-an-unauthorized-modification/) that an unauthorized change to its system prompt caused this.
incidents.description: On 14 May 2025, xAI's Grok chatbot on X answered unrelated questions with claims about “white genocide” in South Africa, [AP reported](https://apnews.com/article/grok-ai-south-africa-64ce5f240061ca0b88d5af4c424e1f3b). [xAI said](https://techcrunch.com/2025/05/15/xai-blames-groks-obsession-with-white-genocide-on-an-unauthorized-modification/) that an unauthorized change to the system prompt caused the replies. The company said that it would publish its system prompts, add review checks and set up a monitoring team.

timeline.title: Unauthorized prompt change and off-topic replies
timeline.description: Grok put claims about South Africa in replies to unrelated posts, [AP reported](https://apnews.com/article/grok-ai-south-africa-64ce5f240061ca0b88d5af4c424e1f3b).

timeline.title: xAI blames an unauthorized modification
timeline.description: xAI said that the change broke its policies and announced new controls, [according to TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2025/05/15/xai-blames-groks-obsession-with-white-genocide-on-an-unauthorized-modification/).

incidents.title: xAI's Grok Posted Antisemitic Content and Called Itself “MechaHitler”
incidents.summary: After an update, Grok posted antisemitic content on X, praised Hitler, and called itself “MechaHitler.” [xAI apologized](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/jul/12/elon-musk-grok-antisemitic) and blamed a code change. In the same week, a [Turkish court blocked access to Grok](https://www.politico.eu/article/turkey-ban-elon-musk-grok-recep-tayyip-erdogan-insult/) over other offensive replies.
incidents.description: On 8 July 2025, xAI's Grok chatbot posted antisemitic replies on X and praised Adolf Hitler, [the Guardian reported](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/jul/12/elon-musk-grok-antisemitic). xAI froze the account and apologized. [xAI said](https://www.engadget.com/ai/grok-team-apologizes-for-the-chatbots-horrific-behavior-and-blames-mechahitler-on-a-bad-update-184520189.html) that a code update, not the language model, made Grok follow extremist views in users' posts, and that it removed this code.

timeline.title: Update goes live
timeline.description: xAI said that a code update went live at about 11 PM PT on 7 July and stayed for 16 hours, [according to Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/ai/grok-team-apologizes-for-the-chatbots-horrific-behavior-and-blames-mechahitler-on-a-bad-update-184520189.html).

timeline.title: Antisemitic posts; xAI freezes the Grok account
timeline.description: xAI froze the Grok account on X on the evening of 8 July, [CNN reported](https://www.cnn.com/2025/07/12/tech/xai-apology-antisemitic-grok-social-media-posts).

timeline.title: Turkish court blocks Grok
timeline.description: A Turkish court blocked access to Grok after offensive replies about Erdoğan, [Politico reported](https://www.politico.eu/article/turkey-ban-elon-musk-grok-recep-tayyip-erdogan-insult/).

timeline.title: xAI apologizes
timeline.description: xAI apologized and blamed a code path upstream of the Grok bot, [the Guardian reported](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/jul/12/elon-musk-grok-antisemitic).

incidents.title: xAI Released Grok 4 Without a Safety Report
incidents.summary: xAI released Grok 4 without a system card. Safety researchers at OpenAI and Anthropic [publicly criticized this](https://techcrunch.com/2025/07/16/openai-and-anthropic-researchers-decry-reckless-safety-culture-at-elon-musks-xai/). xAI published a [model card on 20 August 2025](https://data.x.ai/2025-08-20-grok-4-model-card.pdf).
incidents.description: On 9 July 2025, xAI released its Grok 4 model with no system card or safety report, [Fortune reported](https://fortune.com/2025/07/17/elon-musk-xai-grok-4-no-safety-report/). Safety researchers at OpenAI and Anthropic [criticized the release in public](https://techcrunch.com/2025/07/16/openai-and-anthropic-researchers-decry-reckless-safety-culture-at-elon-musks-xai/). Approximately six weeks later, xAI published a Grok 4 model card and its Risk Management Framework.

incidents.title: xAI's Grok Imagine “Spicy” Mode Made Nude Images of Taylor Swift Without Being Asked
incidents.summary: [The Verge reported](https://www.theverge.com/report/718975/xai-grok-imagine-taylor-swifty-deepfake-nudes) that Grok Imagine's “spicy” mode made topless videos of Taylor Swift without an explicit request. Consumer groups [asked the FTC to investigate](https://www.theverge.com/x-ai/759554/consumer-safety-groups-are-demanding-an-ftc-investigation-into-groks-spicy-mode-elon-musk-grok-imagine-xai).

The prompt did not ask for nudity. Fifteen consumer groups then [asked the FTC](https://www.theverge.com/x-ai/759554/consumer-safety-groups-are-demanding-an-ftc-investigation-into-groks-spicy-mode-elon-musk-grok-imagine-xai) and state attorneys general to investigate the feature.

incidents.title: xAI's Grok Holocaust-Denial Post Added to French Criminal Probe of X
incidents.summary: Grok posted in French that the gas chambers at Auschwitz were for disinfection, not mass murder. The [Paris prosecutor added this to a criminal probe of X](https://apnews.com/article/france-ai-musk-grok-holocaust-e8c952c5d878226aa917d7a65836ed88). In February 2026 police [searched X's Paris office](https://www.npr.org/2026/02/03/g-s1-108490/paris-x-raid-investigation-elon-musk).
incidents.description: On 17 November 2025, Grok wrote in French that the Auschwitz gas chambers were for disinfection against typhus, [AP reported](https://apnews.com/article/france-ai-musk-grok-holocaust-e8c952c5d878226aa917d7a65836ed88). French ministers and rights groups reported the posts, and the Paris prosecutor added them to a cybercrime investigation of X. Later, [police searched X's Paris office](https://www.npr.org/2026/02/03/g-s1-108490/paris-x-raid-investigation-elon-musk), and prosecutors asked Elon Musk to come for a voluntary interview.

incidents.title: xAI's Grok Used to Make Sexualized Images of Real Women and Children
incidents.summary: From late December 2025, users on X asked Grok to “undress” photos of real women and children, and Grok posted many such images. Regulators in the UK, EU, US, Canada, and Asia opened investigations, and [Indonesia and Malaysia blocked Grok](https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/malaysia-restricts-access-grok-ai-backlash-over-sexualised-images-widens-2026-01-12/). [Canada's privacy commissioner found](https://www.priv.gc.ca/en/opc-news/speeches-and-statements/2026/s-d_260611) that X and xAI broke Canadian privacy law.
incidents.description: In late December 2025, users on X asked Grok to edit photos of real women and children into sexualized images, and Grok posted many of them. Regulators in many countries opened investigations, and [Indonesia and Malaysia temporarily blocked Grok](https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/malaysia-restricts-access-grok-ai-backlash-over-sexualised-images-widens-2026-01-12/). [Canada's privacy commissioner found](https://www.priv.gc.ca/en/opc-news/speeches-and-statements/2026/s-d_260611) that X and xAI broke Canadian privacy law.

timeline.title: Wave of “undressing” requests begins
timeline.description: Users asked Grok to edit photos of real women and children into sexualized images, [CNN reported](https://www.cnn.com/2026/01/08/tech/elon-musk-xai-digital-undressing).

timeline.title: Grok post cites “lapses in safeguards”; French ministers report content
timeline.description: Grok acknowledged images of minors in minimal clothing, and French ministers reported content to prosecutors, [Reuters reported](https://www.reuters.com/technology/french-ministers-report-groks-sex-related-content-x-platform-prosecutors-2026-01-02/).

timeline.title: Ofcom contacts X
timeline.description: Ofcom set a deadline of 9 January for X to explain its steps, [according to Ofcom](https://www.ofcom.org.uk/online-safety/illegal-and-harmful-content/ofcom-launches-investigation-into-x-over-grok-sexualised-imagery).

timeline.title: Indonesia and Malaysia block Grok
timeline.description: Indonesia blocked Grok on 10 January and Malaysia on 11 January, [Reuters reported](https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/malaysia-restricts-access-grok-ai-backlash-over-sexualised-images-widens-2026-01-12/).

timeline.title: Ofcom opens formal investigation
timeline.description: Ofcom opened an Online Safety Act investigation into X, [according to Ofcom](https://www.ofcom.org.uk/online-safety/illegal-and-harmful-content/ofcom-launches-investigation-into-x-over-grok-sexualised-imagery).

timeline.title: California opens investigation; X restricts edits
timeline.description: The [California Attorney General opened an investigation](https://oag.ca.gov/news/press-releases/attorney-general-bonta-launches-investigation-xai-grok-over-undressed-sexual-ai), and X said that it blocked edits of real people into revealing clothing where illegal.

timeline.title: California sends cease-and-desist letter
timeline.description: The Attorney General demanded that xAI stop the creation of nonconsensual intimate images and CSAM, [according to his office](https://oag.ca.gov/news/press-releases/attorney-general-bonta-sends-cease-and-desist-letter-xai-demands-it-halt-illegal).

timeline.title: 35 state attorneys general write to xAI
timeline.description: A bipartisan group demanded more action, [according to the New York Attorney General](https://ag.ny.gov/press-release/2026/attorney-general-james-demands-more-action-xai-stop-grok-chatbot-producing).

timeline.title: European Commission opens DSA investigation
timeline.description: The Commission investigates Grok on X and X's recommender systems, [according to the Commission](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/news/commission-investigates-grok-and-xs-recommender-systems-under-digital-services-act).

timeline.title: UK ICO opens investigations into X and xAI
timeline.description: The ICO opened data-protection investigations, [according to the ICO](https://ico.org.uk/about-the-ico/media-centre/news-and-blogs/2026/02/ico-announces-investigation-into-grok/).

timeline.description: The DPC opened a GDPR inquiry into X about the images, [Reuters reported](https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/boards-policy-regulation/ireland-opens-probe-into-musks-grok-ai-over-sexualised-images-2026-02-17/).

timeline.title: Canada's privacy commissioner finds violations
timeline.description: The commissioner found that X and xAI broke federal privacy law, and the companies committed to more measures, [according to the commissioner](https://www.priv.gc.ca/en/opc-news/speeches-and-statements/2026/s-d_260611).

timeline.title: Report: victims seek justice without police help
timeline.description: In the cases examined, police could not charge the perpetrators, [the Bureau of Investigative Journalism reported](https://www.thebureauinvestigates.com/stories/2026-09-29/grok-deepfakes-police-justice).

timeline.description: SpaceXAI (formerly xAI) blocked UK users from making or viewing pornographic images with standalone Grok and stopped its companion chatbots, including “Ani”, from sexually explicit chats with them, [according to Ofcom](https://www.ofcom.org.uk/online-safety/illegal-and-harmful-content/ofcom-update-monitoring-xs-response-to-hate-and-terror-content-and-grok-investigation-latest).

incidents.title: Former Staff Said Safety Work at xAI Was Cut
incidents.summary: [The Washington Post reported](https://www.washingtonpost.com/technology/2026/02/02/elon-musk-grok-porn-generator/) that xAI loosened its guardrails on sexual content. After a wave of departures in February 2026, a former employee [told The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/878761/mass-exodus-at-xai-grok-elon-musk-restructuring) that “safety is a dead org at xAI.” Musk said the company was reorganized to work faster.
incidents.description: [The Washington Post reported](https://www.washingtonpost.com/technology/2026/02/02/elon-musk-grok-porn-generator/) that xAI relaxed its controls on sexual content in Grok. After many staff left xAI, a former employee [told The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/878761/mass-exodus-at-xai-grok-elon-musk-restructuring) that “safety is a dead org at xAI.” Musk said that xAI was reorganized to work faster.

timeline.description: Musk said the reorganization was to “improve the speed of execution,” [NBC News reported](https://www.nbcnews.com/tech/elon-musk/xai-musk-addresses-wave-departures-xai-founder-rcna258651).

incidents.title: Class Actions Allege xAI's Grok Made Child Sexual Abuse Images
incidents.summary: Teenagers from Tennessee filed a [class action against xAI](https://apnews.com/article/musk-xai-grok-child-sexual-abuse-59e58fa581e4f53138738e8936b7c59f). They allege that Grok was used to make sexual images of them as minors. A separate suit filed in August 2026 alleges that xAI training data held child sexual abuse material.
incidents.description: In March 2026, three Tennessee teenagers sued xAI. They allege that a person used Grok to change real photos of them as minors into sexual images, [AP reported](https://apnews.com/article/musk-xai-grok-child-sexual-abuse-59e58fa581e4f53138738e8936b7c59f). The suit later added more victims and named Stability AI as a defendant, [according to NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/09/nx-s1-5885052/spacexai-stabilityai-deepfake-csam-class-action).

incidents.title: Former Engineer Alleges xAI Fired Him for Raising Grok Safety Concerns
incidents.summary: Former engineer Devin Kim [sued xAI and SpaceX](https://www.reuters.com/legal/legalindustry/musks-xai-accused-illegally-firing-engineer-who-raised-safety-concerns-2026-06-10/). incidents.description: Devin Kim, a former xAI engineer, [sued xAI and SpaceX](https://www.reuters.com/legal/legalindustry/musks-xai-accused-illegally-firing-engineer-who-raised-safety-concerns-2026-06-10/) in a California state court on 9 June 2026. [His complaint alleges](https://sanfordheisler.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/2026-06-09-Complaint-Kim-v.-xAI-and-SpaceX.pdf) that xAI fired him because he raised concerns about the safety of Grok. The claims are not proven, and the case continues.

incidents.title: xAI's Rewritten Safety Framework Removed Thresholds and Whistleblower Text
incidents.summary: [The Midas Project reported](https://www.themidasproject.com/watchtower/xai-07112026) that xAI's 30 June 2026 framework removed its numeric risk thresholds, its statement about California's SB 53, and text about whistleblower protections.
incidents.description: xAI replaced its December 2025 safety framework with a [new version](https://media.x.ai/v1/website/xai-frontier-artificial-intelligence-framework-30-june-2026-f1f0c916.pdf) on 30 June 2026. [The Midas Project reported](https://www.themidasproject.com/watchtower/xai-07112026) that the new version removed the numeric risk thresholds, a statement about California's SB 53, and text about whistleblower protections. We found no public statement from xAI about the changes.

incidents.title: xAI's Grok 3 Gave Chemical Weapons Instructions After Launch
incidents.summary: After the release of Grok 3, a developer said that it gave him “hundreds of pages” of chemical weapons instructions, and that [xAI then added guardrails](https://futurism.com/elon-musk-grok-3-chemical-weapons). In Section 2.1 of its [Grok 4 model card](https://data.x.ai/2025-08-20-grok-4-model-card.pdf), xAI said that previous Grok generations showed “a willingness to facilitate serious criminal activity.”
incidents.description: In February 2025, a developer said that xAI's Grok 3 gave him “hundreds of pages” of instructions to make chemical weapons, [Futurism reported](https://futurism.com/elon-musk-grok-3-chemical-weapons). He said that xAI then added guardrails, but that some workarounds still worked. In a later model card, [xAI wrote](https://data.x.ai/2025-08-20-grok-4-model-card.pdf) that previous Grok generations showed “a willingness to facilitate serious criminal activity.”

incidents.title: xAI's Grok 4 Called Itself “Hitler” and Looked Up Musk's Views
incidents.summary: After the launch of Grok 4, users found that it searched for Elon Musk's posts before it answered contested questions. On 15 July 2025, [xAI said on X](https://techcrunch.com/2025/07/15/xai-says-it-has-fixed-grok-4s-problematic-responses/) that Grok 4 also searched the web for its surname and found the “MechaHitler” meme, and that it changed the system prompts.
incidents.description: After xAI released Grok 4 in July 2025, users reported that it searched X for Elon Musk's posts before it answered contested questions. [xAI said](https://techcrunch.com/2025/07/15/xai-says-it-has-fixed-grok-4s-problematic-responses/) that the model also searched the web for its surname and found a “MechaHitler” meme. xAI [changed the system prompts](https://simonwillison.net/2025/Jul/15/xai-mitigated/) and published the changes on GitHub.

incidents.title: xAI's Grok Build Uploaded Whole Code Repositories, Including Secrets
incidents.summary: A security researcher reported that xAI's Grok Build coding agent uploaded users' whole Git repositories, with their history and secrets, to an xAI cloud storage bucket. A server-side change stopped the uploads, and [Elon Musk said](https://www.theregister.com/ai-and-ml/2026/07/14/musk-promises-purge-after-grok-build-caught-sending-entire-repos-to-the-cloud/5271123) that all data uploaded before then would be deleted.
incidents.description: A security researcher [reported](https://gist.github.com/cereblab/dc9a40bc26120f4540e4e09b75ffb547) that xAI's Grok Build coding agent sent developers' whole Git repositories, with their history and secrets, to an xAI cloud storage bucket. A server-side change stopped the uploads. [Elon Musk said](https://www.theregister.com/ai-and-ml/2026/07/14/musk-promises-purge-after-grok-build-caught-sending-entire-repos-to-the-cloud/5271123) that all data uploaded before the change would be deleted.

timeline.title: Researcher publishes upload analysis
timeline.description: cereblab published a [wire-level analysis](https://gist.github.com/cereblab/dc9a40bc26120f4540e4e09b75ffb547) of what Grok Build sent to xAI.

timeline.description: SpaceXAI posted a statement on data retention, Musk promised deletion, and the researcher confirmed that the uploads had stopped, [The Register reported](https://www.theregister.com/ai-and-ml/2026/07/14/musk-promises-purge-after-grok-build-caught-sending-entire-repos-to-the-cloud/5271123).

incidents.title: Researchers Found 35,000 Grok-Built Apps Open to Anyone, Including xAI's Internal Data
incidents.summary: [Security firm Claroc reported](https://blog.claroc.io/ghostshares-grok-build-apps/) that more than 35,000 apps that people built and published with Grok opened for anyone who found their web address, and that passive DNS data listed these addresses. The exposed data included medical exam results, employee rosters and business plans, and 24 of the apps held internal data of SpaceXSI (formerly xAI), [Ars Technica reported](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/11/grok-build-coding-agent-leaks-oodles-of-confidential-info-some-belonging-to-spacexsi/).
incidents.description: [Security firm Claroc reported](https://blog.claroc.io/ghostshares-grok-build-apps/) that more than 35,000 apps that users published with Grok opened for anyone who had the web address, which passive DNS data listed. The exposed data reportedly included medical results, employee lists and internal data of xAI. [According to Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/11/grok-build-coding-agent-leaks-oodles-of-confidential-info-some-belonging-to-spacexsi/), xAI then removed only the apps of its own staff.

timeline.title: xAI removes its own staff's apps only
timeline.description: After Claroc published its findings and Ars Technica sent questions, xAI took down the 24 apps of its staff, but most apps of other users stayed open, [Ars Technica reported](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/11/grok-build-coding-agent-leaks-oodles-of-confidential-info-some-belonging-to-spacexsi/).

timeline.title: Grok calls the report “incorrect”
timeline.description: A post from Grok said that the report was “incorrect” because the apps came from the app builder on grok.com, not Grok Build, and that users see a warning before they publish an app, [The Verge reported](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1031600/spacexsis-grok-build-reportedly-leaked-private-info-from-thousands-of-users-including-its-own-business).

incidents.title: Researchers Say xAI Left Critical Grok Bot Sandbox Flaws Unfixed for Over Two Months
incidents.summary: [Security firm Profero reported](https://profero.io/blog/the-rootkit-built-into-grok-bot/) that one command from xAI's Grok Bot agent, for example after a prompt injection, could give an attacker root access to the user's cloud computer, with its saved logins, connector tokens and files. Profero said that it reported eight flaws to xAI and Cursor on 24 August 2026, and that they were not fixed more than two months later.
incidents.description: [Security firm Profero said](https://profero.io/blog/the-rootkit-built-into-grok-bot/) that one command from xAI's Grok Bot agent, for example after a prompt injection, could give an attacker root access to the user's cloud computer, with its saved logins, tokens and files. Profero said that it reported eight flaws to xAI and Cursor on 24 August 2026, and [that they stayed unfixed](https://news.annanim.ai/en/news/2026-11-09-profero-grok-bot-flaws/) more than two months later.

timeline.title: Profero publishes the flaws
timeline.description: Profero [published its findings](https://profero.io/blog/the-rootkit-built-into-grok-bot/) and said that Cursor sent only an automatic reply, that xAI did not reply, and that the flaws stayed after more than 240 new builds.
